styles.name: Product Launch Reveal
styles.look: A big-tech keynote product film: one glossy hero object on a near-black stage, lit like a studio shot with soft key, rim light, a sweeping specular highlight and a floor reflection, huge tight-tracked sans headlines, gradient key numbers with a soft glow and hairline spec callouts.
styles.motion: Rim light finds the object in the dark, the key light fades up as the camera slowly orbits and pushes in, a highlight glides across the glass, the edge ring ignites, then the headline arrives one word at a time and hairline callouts draw out to their spec labels.
styles.how: Told as a keynote launch film around one hero object (the model, a glass-topped chip): one continuous studio camera that orbits and pushes between beats, hairline callouts and arrows for flow, a clean red strike for the wrong guess while the chip’s inner layers light up backwards to adjust, a giant violet-to-orange 97% with a glow bloom and gleam, and a light-sweep wipe to a pristine white stage for the tagline.

styles.name: Tech Glow Explainer
styles.look: The polished AI / tech YouTube motion-graphics look: deep navy-to-indigo space with drifting electric glows and a perspective grid, gradient-stroked icon tiles wired into node diagrams with light pulses racing along the connectors, dark cards with thin neon borders, gradient headline type and bloom on everything bright.
styles.motion: Smooth eased build: glows bloom up, icon tiles pop in with an overshoot and their line icons draw on, connectors trace out and start carrying light pulses, the headline rises word by word and the stat counts up, all under a slow camera push and drifting particles.
styles.how: One continuous camera: the title shrinks to a header while the brain tile flies into place, labelled examples ride glowing lanes into the model, the camera pushes through the brain into its network (light-speed streaks), Guess/Check/Adjust chips light up as light pulses run forward and a red error pulse runs back, then the camera pans to a glowing accuracy chart and pulls back for the takeaway; numbers count up in gradient Space Grotesk with bloom.

styles.name: Artificial intelligence
styles.look: A prestige-newspaper data graphic on FT salmon: serif headline and dek, hairline grid, one claret highlight series against quiet greys, direct labels and hand-annotated callouts, small-caps source line.
styles.motion: Headline sets, gridlines rule across, grey context lines settle, then the claret line draws left to right with its wash filling behind it and handwritten notes inking in as the line reaches them; a slow push and a soft pulse on the end point hold the shot.
styles.how: Told as a scrolling newspaper story: the page scrolls panel to panel under a sticky serif header, hand-drawn Caveat arrows and rings carry the cause and emphasis, a waffle chart and set numerals count the data, and the accuracy line draws itself like the still.

styles.name: Risograph Zine
styles.look: Three fluorescent spot inks (pink, medium blue, yellow) laid down as separate drum passes and multiplied on off-white stock — misregistered plates, grainy patchy solids, dotted tints and roller streaks.
styles.motion: The sheet goes through the drum three times — yellow, then pink, then blue roll down the page and slide into misregistration — then the print boils at 8 fps while the rocket creeps upward and its flame flickers in the screen.
styles.how: Scenes change by re-registering the plates — yellow, pink and blue slide off and the next scene's plates slide in one drum pass at a time — with dotted blue flow arrows, pink error arrows and scribbled circles, and counters set in big two-plate zine type.

styles.name: Kinetic Type
styles.look: A typographic music-video frame: condensed words cropped edge to edge with zero leading, filled vs outlined, strobe echoes, a slice glitch and one word stretched and filled with a halftone dreamscape — strictly two colours.
styles.motion: One word per beat at 120 bpm: THE punches in, MACHINES whips in from the right trailing outline echoes, LEARNED slams up with a one-frame inverted flash, the TO tab wipes up, DREAM springs open and its halftone moon develops; then the slice glitch and echoes pulse on every beat.
styles.how: Words slam in on the beat and do the explaining; scenes change with a slice-glitch tear and a whip-pan, arrows are heavy rules with chevrons, labels are inverted mono tags that drop onto their targets, and the counters are huge Anton numerals with a strobe-flash on the key hits.

styles.name: Isometric Pastel
styles.look: Clean vector isometric illustration: true 30° projection, flat three-tone face shading, soft pastel palette with a single coral accent, tiny people for scale and long soft shadows on a floating tile.
styles.motion: The floating tile rises into frame, buildings, tanks and racks pop up one by one on springy overshoot, then LEDs blink, fans spin, data cubes stream up and tiny workers stroll during a slow camera push.
styles.how: One long isometric factory floor (data shelves → conveyor → glass-top neural machine → monitor → bar chart) that the camera glides along beat to beat, with white label tags pinned to objects, curved dashed connectors, a counting billboard and an accuracy tag riding the newest bar.

styles.name: International Typographic Style
styles.look: A 1960s Zürich-school concert-style poster: strict 12-column modular grid, enormous flush-left grotesk set tight, an asymmetric field of rotating concentric arc segments over a red disc, and small precise info blocks hung from the grid — red, black and white only.
styles.motion: Rules draw out along the grid, the red disc opens and the ring segments spin in and decelerate until they lock onto a 22.5° module; the headline rises line by line out of its baseline masks and the info blocks step in column by column, then the rings drift like a slow mechanical score.
styles.how: A Zürich-school information sequence on the same 12-column grid: the headline shrinks into a running header, pages change with a column-by-column red wipe, hairline rules with solid heads carry cause and flow, numbers count in Inter 800 and the key result gets a red block slammed behind it.

styles.name: Editorial Essay Collage
styles.look: The editorial "animated essay" collage: warm grainy paper, archival halftone prints with torn white borders and soft shadows, newspaper clippings in serif type with a translucent yellow highlighter sweep, masking tape, flat colour blocks and big cut-out condensed headlines.
styles.motion: Cutouts drop and slide in on 12 fps hand-animated steps while the camera pushes smoothly through parallax layers; the highlighter sweeps left to right and a red marker rings the key detail.
styles.how: Scenes are joined by fast blurred camera whips that hide the cut, plus a new paper sheet slid up on steps; arrows are thin ink route lines and red marker, numbers are re-cut condensed numerals on paper strips, and the emphasis is the yellow highlighter sweep (plus a red marker ring and cross on the wrong guess).

styles.name: Ridgeline
styles.look: Sixty stacked traces of noisy signal, each filled black so it occludes the one behind, drawn as thin white lines in a perfectly centred block with a tiny typographic caption.
styles.motion: Traces are plotted one after another from the top, each swept left to right like a pen recorder and occluding the ones behind; once the stack is complete the peaks ripple like a live signal and the caption types in.
styles.how: Each white trace is one training round: a recorder tape feeds labelled pulses into the empty stack, three magnified traces act out guess / check / adjust (the peak lands on "dog", a dashed target shows "cat", the peak slides over), then the camera pulls back and sixty rounds plot themselves as the noisy peaks align into one clean ridge, captioned in Space Mono.

styles.name: Low-Poly Faceted
styles.look: Faceted low-poly 3D: a triangulated noise terrain with flat per-face Lambert shading, atmospheric depth fog, cone trees and a faceted rocket lifting off into a dawn gradient sky.
styles.motion: Terrain facets flip into place from the camera out to the horizon, trees and the launch pad pop up, then the rocket ignites and lifts off on a faceted flame and smoke column while the camera dollies forward.
styles.how: A continuous camera flight through one faceted valley (overview → river of labelled example cards → floating crystal model whose facets realign → pillar chart on a plateau → pull back), with angular two-tone ribbon arrows, cut-corner tags pinned to objects and Space Grotesk counters.

styles.name: Punk Zine Collage
styles.fontsLine: Abril Fatface, Anton, Archivo Black, Bebas Neue, Black Ops One, Courier Prime, DM Serif Display, Fraunces, Inter, Limelight, Oswald, Permanent Marker, Playfair Display, Rubik Mono One, Shrikhand, Special Elite, UnifrakturMaguntia
styles.look: A photocopied cut-and-paste zine spread: torn halftone scraps, ransom-note letters cut from mismatched magazines, masking tape and staples, crushed to high-contrast black toner with one fluoro-pink spot ink overprinted off-register.
styles.motion: Scraps slam onto the page one per beat with a copier-flash flicker, ransom letters jitter in stop-motion, toner noise boils every frame.
styles.how: Shot on 8 fps steps, each beat is a new photocopied sheet slapped down over the last (copier flash on impact); arrows are marker scrawls, labels are typed strips and ransom letters pasted onto the thing they name, the counter is re-cut from magazine letters every time it ticks, and the wrong guess gets slashed with the pink spot ink.

styles.name: Glassmorphism UI
styles.look: Frosted-glass UI: translucent panels that genuinely blur the vivid gradient blobs and orbs behind them, with 1px light borders, a diagonal specular sheen, fine frost grain and crisp Inter type.
styles.motion: Color blobs bloom up under the glass, the frosted card rises in, then the chat plays out (user bubble pops, the AI reply types itself line by line) while stat chips float in glass-over-glass and their ring and sparkline draw on; blobs keep drifting so the frost shimmers.
styles.how: The camera glides and zooms across one big frosted dashboard (data feed → network card → output chat → accuracy chart → pull back) while the live colour blobs drift behind, so every panel re-frosts as it moves; connectors are glowing gradient lines with travelling light dots, labels are glass pills, numbers count in big Inter 800.

styles.name: ISOTYPE Pictograms
styles.look: Vienna Method pictorial statistics: rows of identical flat pictograms where each symbol is a fixed quantity, partial symbols for remainders, three muted litho inks on a strict grid with geometric sans lettering.
styles.motion: Title and key set first, the year column drops in, then symbols are stamped out row by row from the centre in stepped, rubber-stamp timing, the 2025 row of machines racing ahead; the litho paper breathes in the hold.
styles.how: A Vienna-Method picture-statistic told across one long chart sheet the camera pans along: symbols are stamped in stepped 12 fps timing, flat Isotype arrows show flow, numerals are stamped and re-stamped, and accuracy is counted in rows of tick symbols with partial symbols for fractions.
